ai.q: ANYBODY HERE USING AI FOR REAL?
ai.say: anybody here using A.I. for real?

nextgen.q: KNOW ANYBODY WHO STARTED A BUSINESS THIS YEAR?
nextgen.say: know anybody who started a business this year?

ism_new_orders.name: ISM NEW ORDERS
ism_new_orders.means: Purchasing managers, this month against last: share saying orders rose, plus half of those saying the same. Seasonally adjusted. 50 is even.
ism_new_orders.caveat: Theirs counts SAME as half and is adjusted for the season. Yours is UP over UP plus DOWN.

btos_ai_use.name: CENSUS AI-USE RATE
btos_ai_use.means: Share of businesses answering yes to the Census question on using AI in the last two weeks. The exact wording is on the tag card.
btos_ai_use.caveat: Theirs keeps DON'T KNOW in the total. Yours is YES over YES plus NO.

bfs_applications.name: BUSINESS APPLICATIONS
bfs_applications.means: New business applications filed in the month, seasonally adjusted.
bfs_applications.caveat: A count, not a share. It gets no hand on the dial.

bls_power_price.name: POWER PRICE
bls_power_price.means: Average price of a kilowatt-hour of electricity, U.S. city average.
bls_power_price.caveat: A price, not a share. It gets no hand on the dial.
